_agent_hints.about: Keys starting with _ guide AI agents; repogov ignores them.
_agent_hints.on_fail: Over its limit: split the file or move detail to docs/. Raise a limit only if the user asks.
_agent_hints.on_warn: Near its limit: trim before adding.
_agent_hints.on_pitfall: The agent silently ignores that file: apply the FIX hint.
_agent_hints.on_settings: An agent settings finding: report it to the user; never widen permissions.
_agent_hints.exempt: Limit 0 under files, only for generated or append-only files; tell the user.
never: Edit files outside of this repo.
Read or paste secrets: .env, keys, certificates.
Bypass security controls (signing, hooks, permissions) to finish a task.
_agent_hints.verify: Run 'repogov -root . all' and the tests; apply each FIX hint.

keys.language: Prose language (BCP 47, e.g. en-US): write docs, comments and commits in it.
keys.warning_threshold: Percent of a limit where WARN starts (85 or "85%").
keys.rules: Line limits by glob; first match wins.
keys.max_bytes: Byte limits by glob; some agents truncate large files.
